findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization with pickle
 * @description Using pickle.load/loads on untrusted data can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe deserialization using pickle which can lead to arbitrary code execution

message.text: Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure temporary file usage
 * @description Using insecure temporary file creation can lead to race conditions and security issues
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-temp-file
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-377
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember(["mktemp"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["tempnam", "tmpnam"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Insecure temporary file creation that may lead to race conditions."
findings.hypothesis: Check for insecure temporary file creation using deprecated functions like mktemp, tempnam, or tmpnam

message.text: Insecure temporary file creation that may lead to race conditions.
